verdict.rationale: AFK is a SaaS operations platform, so a developer platform for custom connectors is a fair question. The evidence only describes vendor-built integrations (Mercury, Gusto, Carta, Stripe) and a bare "GitHubCode" link label. Nothing documents an SDK, CLI, API, or a way to build private connectors, and probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404.
